verdict.rationale: Milvus documents a dedicated 'Milvus Distributed' mode on Kubernetes clusters serving billions of vectors, distinct from single-machine Standalone mode, and claims stable tens-of-billions scale. A community comment independently cites horizontal scaling as a Milvus strength; a second scale claim comes from a self-described possibly biased Milvus team member. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sharding/partitioning mechanics, distributed deployment and operations guidance (node scaling, replication), and independent hands-on reports of multi-node operation.
